_meta.extraction_note: Values transcribed from the arXiv PDF via two independent paths: (a) pdftotext, (b) an independent subagent's visual read of the rendered page, plus (c) a direct visual read of rendered PDF p.115 to break ties. 50/52 Instruct+Think cells agreed across (a) and (b). Two cells conflicted and were resolved against the rendered page (c): WildGuard-Test DPO Instruct = 99.9 (pdftotext had 99.8); WildJailbreak-Benign Final Instruct = 98.0 (subagent had 96.9). STILL NOT human-verified end-to-end. See Gate 0 STOP in INBOX.md.

_meta.columns_extracted: Only the Olmo 3 7B own columns (SFT, DPO, Final). Baseline model columns (Qwen, OLMo 2, etc.) were NOT transcribed; they are out of scope.
_meta.global_metric_convention: Report A.8.2: all metrics normalized so higher = better (1 = perfect safety). Reported as the average of: refusal accuracy (=1-ASR) for DoAnythingNow, HarmBench, WildGuard, TrustLLM-JailbreakTrigger, Toxigen, StrongReject; accuracy for XSTest and BBQ; inverted-ASR for WildJailbreak(harmful) and ASR for WildJailbreak(benign); inverted accuracy (error rate) for WMDP. Safety benchmarks evaluated at top-p 0.95, temperature 0.7.
_meta.value_scale: Percentages (0-100), except BBQ Bias-Ambig / Bias-Disambig which are bias scores that can be negative and near 0.
